$comment: Catalogue elements that the G20 parts (design/overlay/g20_parts.json) have and design/overlay/g20_comfort.json lacked. tools/overlay/link_parts.py adds each one to the catalogue (after the existing 38, which it never changes) and fills every element's 'parts' list. The judgement here is by hand, like tools/overlay/relations_g20.json; 'bbox' is not given: it is the union of the element's parts (their alpha extent), computed by the script. Basis and states quote the sources the simulation gives (bench/g20/manifest.json 'sources', docs/G20SIM-REPORT.md section 5). Considered and NOT added: the numerals and the scale labels (the simulation links them to structure.speedo / structure.tacho, and the catalogue's 'excluded' already counts them in those ghost outlines), the map veil (linked to map.region, which already covers the 'lighter map background seen in 14').

The relation rests on one theme-connected photo (14, our pixels transparent there); 10-13 were not assessed for the background. The 6WB Dials + G20 collar takes its colour (tools/bake_scene.py).
